pages.text: Blackberries are harvested from fully grown Blackberry Crops.$(br2)To begin growing them, obtain Blackberry Seeds and plant them on farmland.
Plant Blackberry Seeds on farmland. When the crop reaches full maturity, harvesting it produces 1 Blackberry and 2 Blackberry Seeds.
Blackberries are edible and can also be used to make Blackberry Jam.
